description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/japanese_room/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/japanese_room/questions.pdf; its answer (3) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation; hard = two chained relations.
Only large, unambiguous objects are counted. Structural classes (wall/floor/ceiling) and the many small tableware items are excluded except where a relation makes them unambiguous.
'Potted plant' is avoided as a count target because the scene separately labels three 'flowers' objects that are also planted in pots, so a human would count them inconsistently.
The room is a tatami room with a low dining table and four floor cushions, a display alcove with a ledge under three calligraphy scrolls, and two side stands holding a vase and a jar.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.
